title: Show later host source discrepancies against sealed evaluated work
outcome: A completed item's bounded agent views expose a later matching host source sighting that differs from its sealed evaluated source. The diagnostic is derived from existing immutable records: completion remains final, with no reopening, seal rewrite, new obligation, durable record, field or index derivation. Queue: Opus after bundle 9. TermAl's re-scoped flag-on/unknown-policy diagnostics proceed independently.
acceptance: The diagnostic derives from existing seal, bound evaluation and source-observation records, comparing only the same run, workspace/root generation and original seal claim/fence. It reports the compared source basis and seal/evaluation/observation record ids. No new durable record, field or index derivation is introduced; any need for one is classified before coding proceeds.

For opening source A, an evaluation of A and immediate done sealing that evaluation, a later matching closing sighting of B visibly reports 'later source sighting differs from sealed evaluated source' even when source_changed is false. Completion remains sealed, with no reopen, rewrite or new obligation; the diagnostic does not assert that the write occurred after the seal.

A later equal sighting of A is described only as reported endpoint agreement, never as proof of source at done, absence of intermediate writes or boundary certification. It does not erase a previously recorded discrepancy.

Missing closing evidence or judged basis, an unreadable or unrelated sighting, and a wrong workspace, root generation or claim/fence never become a confirmation. Unadmitted/audit-only facts retain their status and scope. Exact done-turn attribution is shown only when retained host turn/grant correlation establishes it; timestamps alone do not.

Duplicate delivery reuses the original immutable observation locator without creating a duplicate durable diagnostic. Reopened generations and historical observations keep their original run association; completed child and parent seals, selected evidence lists, acceptance and accounting remain unchanged.

Completed show and next, through both CLI and MCP, expose the same bounded diagnostic with recoverable observation detail and exact continuation for omitted facts. Run-feed ordering against the seal's completion cut supplies recorded-before/after; no hot-path whole-root scan or hashing is added.

Tests demonstrate the preceding positive, equal, missing, mismatched, duplicate, unadmitted and reopened/child/historical cases. Contract prose states the observation interval and immediate finality explicitly, and retains the current done fingerprint/policy behavior.

completion.summary: Shipped bounded sealed-source diagnostics for completed show and next across CLI/MCP, with historical observation navigation, scoped comparisons and explicit interval/finality limits. Completion, seals, acceptance and accounting remain unchanged. Landed in Batch D; exact full gate and independent review pair passed.
